subject: System Design
title: Replication: Copies for Safety
description: One-minute skill: Replication: Copies for Safety.

hook.text: If your only database server dies, all your data is gone. Replication keeps copies on multiple machines.

buildup.text: A primary database handles writes and replicates changes to one or more read replicas.

discovery.text: Replicas serve read traffic, reducing load on the primary and surviving if one machine fails.

twist.text: Replication lag means replicas might serve slightly stale data. Seconds matter in financial systems.

climax.text: Replication trades perfect consistency for durability and read performance.

punchline.text: Copies protect data and speed up reads.

quiz.question: What is replication lag?
options: Delay before replicas reflect the latest writes
Time to create a new replica
